newsitem.title: JAPAN: Four Japan contractors to establish business ties.
newsitem.headline: Four Japan contractors to establish business ties.

text.p: Four medium-sized Japanese contractors announced a two-year cooperation agreement on Wednesday, covering areas including technology development, machinery purchases and security controls.

Nakano Corp, Katsumura Construction Co Ltd, Daito Kogyo Co Ltd, and Nitto Construction Co Ltd said in a separate statements they decided to cooperate to achieve higher productivity and to support technology development. But they also said the agreement would not lead to a merger of the firms, which would maintain separate competitive sales activities.
